biological.citation: Multiple interactions recruit BLTP2 to ER-PM contacts to control plasma membrane dynamics (PMID: 40899996)
biological.summary: BLTP2/KIAA0100 is a bridge-like lipid transfer protein that mediates bulk lipid transport between the ER and PM by tethering the ER to tubular endosomes and macropinosomes. BLTP2 binds to the PM through interactions with phosphoinositides, adaptor proteins FAM102A/FAM102B, and N-BAR domain proteins. Absence of BLTP2 results in accumulation of intracellular vacuoles connected to the PM, indicating a role in PM dynamics control.

biological.citation: KIAA0100 Modulates Cancer Cell Aggression Behavior of MDA-MB-231 through Microtubule and Heat Shock Proteins (PMID: 29867023)
biological.summary: KIAA0100 silencing by siRNA in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells reduced cell aggregation, reattachment, metastasis, and invasion, and sensitized quiescent cells to anoikis. KIAA0100 stabilizes microtubule structure as a microtubule-binding protein and interacts with heat shock protein HSPA1A to confer anoikis resistance.

biological.citation: Preparation of monoclonal antibody against human KIAA0100 protein and Northern blot analysis of human KIAA0100 gene (PMID: 29404037)
biological.summary: Northern blot analysis in U937 cells revealed that human KIAA0100 gene produces two different mRNA products (6000-10000 bp and 5000-6000 bp), and Western blot showed two protein products (254 kDa and <250 kDa), indicating alternative splicing or post-translational modification.

biological.citation: Bioinformatic prediction and functional characterization of human KIAA0100 gene (PMID: 29404013)
biological.summary: CRISPR/Cas9-mediated downregulation of KIAA0100 in U937 cells inhibited cell proliferation and promoted apoptosis. Bioinformatic analysis predicted KIAA0100 localizes to the secretory pathway, contains a signal peptide, transmembrane region, and four FMP27 domains. KIAA0100 is proposed as a novel anti-apoptotic factor in acute monocytic leukemia.

biological.citation: Circ_0000520 interacts with miR-512-5p to upregulate KIAA0100 to promote malignant behaviors in lung cancer (PMID: 35866672)
biological.summary: KIAA0100 is a target of miR-512-5p in lung cancer; the circ_0000520/miR-512-5p/KIAA0100 axis regulates lung cancer cell proliferation, cell cycle progression, migration, invasion, and angiogenesis. KIAA0100 upregulation promotes malignant behaviors in lung cancer cells.

biological.citation: Multiple interactions mediate the localization of BLTP2 at ER-PM contacts to control plasma membrane dynamics (PMID: 39974967)
biological.summary: BLTP2/KIAA0100 localizes at ER-PM contacts through interactions with phosphoinositides, adaptor proteins FAM102A and FAM102B, and N-BAR domain proteins. The protein mediates bulk lipid transport between ER and PM and controls PM dynamics through lipid transfer function.

biological.citation: Identification of BCOX1, a novel gene overexpressed in breast cancer (PMID: 16289875)
biological.summary: BCOX1 (homologous to KIAA0100) is overexpressed in breast carcinoma with mRNA signal localized to the cytoplasm of cancer epithelial cells. BCOX1 mRNA expression is moderately elevated in ductal in situ carcinoma, peaks in invasive and metastatic breast carcinoma, and is absent in benign ductal epithelial cells.

biological.citation: Profiling the Somatic Mutational Landscape of Breast Tumors from Hispanic/Latina Women Reveals Conserved and Unique Characteristics (PMID: 37145128)
biological.summary: Whole-exome and RNA sequencing of 146 breast tumors from Hispanic/Latina women identified a recurrent copy-number amplification at 17q11.2 associated with high KIAA0100 gene expression that has been implicated in breast cancer aggressiveness. This amplification was more prevalent in Hispanic/Latina compared to non-Hispanic White women.

biological.citation: Bioinformatics-based modeling of lung squamous cell carcinoma prognosis and prediction of immunotherapy response (PMID: 39724502)
biological.summary: KIAA0100 was identified as one of 11 key genes in a Cox proportional risk model for predicting lung squamous cell carcinoma patient survival and prognosis. Gene expression variation of KIAA0100 between normal and cancerous lung tissues was significantly associated with patient survival outcomes.
